description_en: Queries knowledge bases in a specified workspace of the current tenant by using paging. Each returned item includes the status and lastError fields, which can be used to query the creation and deletion progress of knowledge bases and the causes of failures
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户指定工作空间中的知识库；每项返回 status 和 lastError，可用于查询知识库创建、删除进度及失败原因
name: ListKnowledgeBases

parameters.help_en: The AgentCore workspace ID. Magic resolves the tenant ID from the trusted gateway identity and verifies workspace ownership. Knowledge bases are created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. You cannot query knowledge bases across tenants by using only the knowledge base ID
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. If you do not specify this parameter or set it to 0, the default value 20 is used. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 未传或传 0 时使用默认值 20，取值范围为 0～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 首次查询不传；后续传入上一次响应中的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

items.description_en: The list of knowledge bases returned on the current page
items.description_zh: 当前页返回的知识库列表

chunkConfiguration.description_en: The valid configuration with parsed default values. It only affects subsequently uploaded or explicitly reprocessed assets
chunkConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析默认值的有效配置，仅影响后续新上传或显式重新处理的资产

headingLevel.description_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING. Valid values: 1 to 6. Headings at or above this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence splitting. Documents without headings fall back to intelligent splitting. Ignored for other strategies and validated by the backend based on the strategy
headingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

maxChunkSize.description_en: The maximum chunk size, ranging from 1 to 6,000 characters. It follows the character length metric of EB and is not the token count. If omitted, the server-side default value is used
maxChunkSize.description_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值

overlapSize.description_en: The overlap size in characters. It takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. Default value: 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize. The total length after overlapping must not exceed the maximum chunk size. Ignored for other strategies and validated by the backend based on the strategy
overlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

preprocessRules.description_en: The text preprocessing rules applied before splitting
preprocessRules.description_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则

removeUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
removeUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址

replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格

separator.description_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the literal string as a whole without using regular expressions. Ignored for other strategies
separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略

strategy.description_en: The saved chunking strategy. Valid values: AUTO (automatic chunking) and BY_SEPARATOR (separator-based chunking). BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for backward compatibility with historical configurations. Only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted when you create or update a configuration in the first phase
strategy.description_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR

createdAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

embeddingDimension.description_en: The effective vector dimensions. Default value: 1024. It cannot be modified after creation
embeddingDimension.description_zh: 实际生效的向量维度，默认 1024，创建后不可修改

embeddingModel.description_en: The effective model name. It cannot be modified after creation. Default value: text-embedding-v4
embeddingModel.description_zh: 实际生效的模型名称，创建后不可修改；默认 text-embedding-v4

enumValueTitles.qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash: 通义文本向量极速模型 3.7（qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v3: 通义文本向量模型 v3（text-embedding-v3）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v4: 通义文本向量模型 v4（text-embedding-v4）

knowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable knowledge base ID generated by the platform. It is persistently bound to the tenantId and workspaceId. Queries and modifications must verify all three identifiers simultaneously. Access based solely on the ID is not allowed
knowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 平台生成的稳定知识库 ID，持久化绑定 tenantId 和 workspaceId；查询和变更必须同时校验三者，不得仅凭 ID 访问

lastError.description_en: The desensitized error summary when a lifecycle operation fails
lastError.description_zh: 生命周期操作失败时的脱敏错误摘要

code.description_en: The stable product error code. Internal task identifiers, stacks, or storage addresses are not returned
code.description_zh: 稳定的产品错误码；不返回内部任务标识、堆栈或存储地址

message.description_en: The desensitized error summary that can be displayed to users
message.description_zh: 可向用户展示的脱敏错误摘要

metadataSchema.description_en: The metadata schema. It is determined upon creation and cannot be modified afterward. It includes constant or system variable configurations
metadataSchema.description_zh: 创建时确定，创建后不可修改；包含常量或系统变量配置

name.description_en: The name of the metadata field for the knowledge base in the workspace. It must be unique within the same schema and cannot occupy system control fields
name.description_zh: 工作空间内知识库的元数据字段名；同一 schema 中唯一，不得占用系统控制字段

type.description_en: The field type. Valid values: STRING, LONG, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, and DATETIME. Uploaded and updated string values are parsed by the backend according to this type. Nested objects are not accepted
type.description_zh: STRING、LONG、DOUBLE、BOOLEAN 或 DATETIME。上传和更新的字符串 value 由后端按此类型解析；不接受嵌套对象

value.description_en: The fixed value or system variable name. The following variables are retained: DOCUMENT_NAME, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_URI, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME. DOCUMENT_* refers to the original asset in this operation, and the variable names are retained for EB compatibility
value.description_zh: 固定值或系统变量名。沿用 DOCUMENT_NAME、FILE_TYPE、FILE_SIZE、DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME、SOURCE_TYPE、SOURCE_URI、SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME；DOCUMENT_* 在本接口中指资产原件，变量名保留 EB 兼容性

valueMode.description_en: The value mode. CONSTANT indicates a constant: a fixed value is used if the value is not empty, and the value is assigned during upload if not configured. SYSTEM_VARIABLE indicates a system-generated value that cannot be overwritten by customers. The mode cannot be modified after the schema is created
valueMode.description_zh: CONSTANT 表示常量：value 非空时使用固定值，未配置值时由上传赋值；SYSTEM_VARIABLE 表示由系统生成，客户不得覆盖。schema 创建后不可修改

name.description_en: The display name of the knowledge base

regionId.description_en: The region where the knowledge base is located. It is consistent with the workspace to which it belongs and is maintained by the server
regionId.description_zh: 知识库所在地域，与所属工作空间一致，由服务端维护

searchConfiguration.description_en: The valid search configuration with parsed platform default values. It can be overridden by a single search request
searchConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析平台默认值的有效检索配置，可由单次检索请求覆盖

mode.description_en: The retrieve mode. Valid values: KEYWORD (keyword retrieve), VECTOR (vector retrieve), and HYBRID (hybrid retrieve). The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, HYBRID is used
mode.description_zh: KEYWORD 为关键词检索，VECTOR 为向量检索，HYBRID 为混合检索。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 HYBRID

rankAlgorithm.description_en: The ranking algorithm. Valid values: RRF (reciprocal rank fusion) and WEIGHTED (weighted normalization fusion). It takes effect only in HYBRID mode. Default value: RRF
rankAlgorithm.description_zh: RRF 为倒数排名融合，WEIGHTED 为加权归一融合。仅 HYBRID 生效，系统默认 RRF

rerankEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether reranking is enabled by default. It applies to all three search modes. An explicit specification in the request overrides this configuration. If neither is configured, the value is false
rerankEnabled.description_zh: 适用于三种检索模式；请求显式指定时覆盖本配置，均未配置时为 false

rerankModel.description_en: Specifies the rerank model. Valid values: qwen3-rerank, qwen3.7-text-rerank, gte-rerank-v2, and qwen3-vl-rerank. The request parameter takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is specified, qwen3-rerank is used
rerankModel.description_zh: 支持 qwen3-rerank、qwen3.7-text-rerank、gte-rerank-v2、qwen3-vl-rerank；请求优先于本配置，均未配置时使用 qwen3-rerank

enumValueTitles.gte-rerank-v2: 通用文本重排模型 v2（gte-rerank-v2）

rrfK.description_en: The k parameter for RRF. Default value: 60. The value must be greater than 0
rrfK.description_zh: RRF 的 k 参数，系统默认 60，必须大于 0

topK.description_en: The maximum number of results to return. Maximum value: 100. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, 10 is used. The actual number of results may be less than this value after permission and release version filtering
topK.description_zh: 最多返回 100 条。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 10；权限和发布版本过滤后可能不足该数量

vectorWeight.description_en: The vector path weight for WEIGHTED. Default value: 0.7. The keyword path weight is 1 minus this value
vectorWeight.description_zh: WEIGHTED 的向量路权重，系统默认 0.7，关键词路权重为 1 减去此值

status.description_en: The lifecycle status. You can query the creation progress by using GetKnowledgeBase and ListKnowledgeBases. Valid values: Creating (creation in progress), Active (creation successful), and CreateFailed (creation failed). A deletion acceptance response may return Deleting, DeleteFailed, or Deleted. After deletion is accepted, GetKnowledgeBase indicates that the resource does not exist, ListKnowledgeBases no longer displays the resource, and the backend continues cleanup. For the cause of a creation failure, refer to lastError
status.description_zh: GetKnowledgeBase 和 ListKnowledgeBases 可查询创建进度：Creating 为创建中，Active 为创建成功，CreateFailed 为创建失败。删除受理响应可返回 Deleting、DeleteFailed 或 Deleted；删除受理后 GetKnowledgeBase 返回资源不存在，ListKnowledgeBases 不再显示该资源，后台继续清理。创建失败原因见 lastError

tenantId.description_en: The read-only tenant ownership. It is resolved by Magic based on the trusted gateway call identity and bound during creation. It matches the tenant of the associated workspace. Client-specified values or modifications are not accepted
tenantId.description_zh: 只读租户归属，由 Magic 根据可信网关调用身份解析并在创建时绑定，与所属工作空间的租户一致；不接受客户端指定或修改

updatedAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

workspaceId.description_en: The AgentCore workspace to which the resource belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AgentCore 工作空间

maxResults.description_en: The page size used for the current request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求采用的分页大小

message.description_en: The description of the data masking result

nextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Pass the nextToken value from the previous response as is to continue pagination. If the value is empty, no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 继续分页时原样传入上一次响应中的 nextToken；为空时结束

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of knowledge bases in the current workspace. Pagination ends when nextToken is empty
totalCount.description_zh: 当前工作空间的知识库总数；翻页终止以 nextToken 为空为准
